text: ベトベターって　うみの　ヘドロから　うまれたの

structure.jp: うみの　ヘドロから　うまれたの
structure.en: was born from the sludge of the sea

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a name is a casual way to bring up what you are about to talk about. ベトベターって = 'Grimer, you know'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is the soft, often feminine form of のだ and gives an explaining tone. うまれたの = 'it was born, you see'.
